verdict.rationale: An in-product AI insights feature, such as AI analysis of logs, metrics or usage, is a reasonable thing for a cloud platform to offer, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows nothing of the kind. Fly.io's AI-related material covers hosting agents (Sprites), running MCP servers, and an experimental flyctl MCP server. Its diagnostics (`fly doctor`) are rule-based checks, not AI-generated insights.
